status: DRAFT for Alex, Cam and Viv to correct. Not accepted. Phase 1 is done when all three accept it and a clip takes under 5 minutes.
scope: Front-foot drive, controlled along the ground, filmed from the bowler's end. Score this shot, not the player.

rating_scale.1: Partly done, or a small fault
rating_scale.X: Cannot judge from this clip (say why)

checkpoints.text: Head level and still at set-up; eyes level
Balanced base at set-up; weight even, knees relaxed
checkpoints.visible: partly: stance width lies along the pitch

checkpoints.text: Hands lift straight back, not out towards gully or across the body
checkpoints.visible: yes for hands; the bat is not tracked

checkpoints.text: Head and front shoulder lead towards the line of the ball
checkpoints.visible: yes for line; no for forward movement

checkpoints.text: Front foot lands close to the line of the ball
Front knee bends and takes the weight
Body stays side-on until contact; chest does not open early
checkpoints.visible: yes: the shoulder line widens as it opens

checkpoints.text: Downswing comes straight through the line of the ball
One rhythm from backlift to contact; no pause or hitch
Head over the ball at contact; does not fall away
Balance held at the finish; no fall to the off or leg side
Hands continue through towards the target; finish controlled, not checked or wild

not_judged_from_this_camera: Stride length and weight forward (depth along the pitch)
Contact under the eyes, beside the front pad
Timing and where the ball went

faults_in_chain_order.text: Head moves early or is not still at set-up
Backlift goes wide or across the body
Head and shoulder do not lead to the line
Front foot not to the line of the ball
Front leg stiff; weight stays back
Pause or hitch in the swing

priority_fix_rule: Pick ONE fault: the one that, fixed first, would help this player most. This is usually the earliest fault in the chain, because later faults often follow from it.

access.5: Plays across the line: foot well away from the line, chest open early, hands out wide
access.15: Gets near the line, but opens a little early or the hands drift
access.25: Foot to the line, side-on to contact, hands straight through the line

tracking.5: Head moves early and falls away at contact
tracking.15: Head mostly still, leads late, drifts a little at contact
tracking.25: Still, level head that leads to the line and stays over the ball

stability.5: Unbalanced from set-up, falls away at the finish
stability.15: Balanced, but the weight stays back or the finish wobbles
stability.25: Balanced base, weight onto a bent front knee, finish held

flow.5: Stop-start: pause at the top, hitch, checked finish
flow.25: One smooth rhythm from backlift to a full, controlled finish

score_sheet_notes.overall: Score it on its own (0-100); do not add up the pillars. Phase 2 tests whether coaches overall equals the pillar sum.
